item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-11-06
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天论坛最集中的动静来自 Spark Program 的集中评审：MeterNet 获批 680 美元（以 CKB 支付）的 grant，但附带补充报告条件 [S04]；同时 Light dApp Kit、CellFlow、TapFiber 和 Spark Verify 等提案被委员会拒绝 [S07, S08, S09, S11]。官网改版讨论也有新进展，有人指出 Journey 页面内容停留在 2024 年 7 月，并把 2023 年硬分叉仍标为进行中或即将推出 [S01, S02]。此外，Fiber Studio v1.1.3 发布、Seedsong 开放 mint、Noir-CKB 测试网上线等产品动态也在今天出现 [S03, S15, S16]。 ## 重点话题 Spark Program：MeterNet 提案获 680 USD grant，条件是最终报告要包含现场试点和公开 Web MVP 的用户反馈总结；申请者已接受条件 [S04, S05]。 Spark Program 评审结果密集：Light dApp Kit、CellFlow、TapFiber、Spark Verify 均被拒 [S07, S08, S09, S11]；Spark Verify 作者表示理解决定，会继续独立推进 CKB Verify [S12]。 官网更新：讨论提出 Journey 页面最后更新于 2024 年 7 月，建议把“CKB Hardfork 2023”从未完成或即将推出移到成就，并提到 Meepo 硬分叉自 2025 年 7 月 1 日已上主网...

item.title: Web page www.nervos.org - Discussion for new pull request (2 posts)
item.description: Goal nervos.org is often the first place newcomers, investors and developers look. This topic collects the community’s ideas for improving it. For example, parts of the site still describe 2023: the “CKB Hardfork 2023” is listed as upcoming, Godwoken is recommended even though it was sunset, and the first halving is “expected around Nov 2023”. The idea: collect the outdated content in one place, agree on the changes as a community, and turn them into a pull request, so the site reflects where CKB really is today. item.title: Let any wallet bind its Nervos DAO deposit on Metaforo (1 posts)
item.description: An update since the post. Ward is now on npm as `ckb-ward` 0.1.0, with a browser entry for wallets and the verifier for platforms. The Cellula wallet signs Ward proofs on testnet. A site asks, and the wallet shows which site is asking and for which account. It refuses a proof meant for another site or another network. We tested it today through the wallet’s own screen, with a starter account, a guarded account and a real phone passkey. Ward’s verifier accepted each proof, and refused a replay and a changed signature byte. For Metaforo this means one verifier covers JoyID, multisig, Omnilock and smart account deposits. Happy to help wire it in. github.com GitHub - LusoCryptoLabs/ckb-ward:...

item.title: Spark Program | Spark Verify - Reproducible Acceptance Checks for CKB Projects (2 posts)
item.description: Hi @Akane, Thank you for taking the time to revise the proposal based on our earlier feedback. The committee has completed its review and, after careful discussion, regrets to reject the Spark Verify proposal at this time. The proposal describes a format for declaring observable results (committed/rejected transactions, cell states, balance changes, cycle usage) plus a runner to verify them on a local OffCKB devnet.
